items.name: Frontier Airlines
items.blurb: A direct pipeline to one of the country's largest ultra-low-cost carriers — built around airline-style training from day one.

items.name: Key Lime Air
items.blurb: A long-standing relationship with the regional carrier — a route to Part 121 hours and the right seat for graduates ready to fly the line.

items.name: GoJet Airlines
items.blurb: A regional carrier flying for United Express — another established pathway from DCFA training to a Part 121 cockpit.

items.name: MSU Denver
items.blurb: Metropolitan State University of Denver — Colorado's only four-year school with FAA-approved R-ATP eligibility. The partnership lets degree-seeking students reach a Restricted ATP at 1,000 flight hours instead of 1,500, accelerating the path to the airlines by roughly a year.
